validated_results.title: The yin and yang of 15-lipoxygenase-1 and delta-desaturases: dietary omega-6 linoleic acid metabolic pathway in prostate.
validated_results.reason: This study compared mRNA expression of arachidonic acid pathway enzymes in donor prostates versus prostate tumors, providing tumor-tissue molecular data with no arachidonic acid exposure measure or prostate cancer incidence estimate.

validated_results.title: The yin and yang of 15-lipoxygenase-1 and delta-desaturases: dietary omega-6 linoleic acid metabolic pathway in prostate.
validated_results.reason: Linoleic acid appears only as a metabolic pathway concept in a tumor-versus-normal tissue gene expression analysis, with no measured dietary or circulating linoleic acid exposure and no incidence outcome.

validated_results.title: Dietary gamma-linolenate attenuates tumor growth in a rodent model of prostatic adenocarcinoma via suppression of elevated generation of PGE(2) and 5S-HETE.
validated_results.journal: Prostaglandins, leukotrienes, and essential fatty acids
validated_results.reason: The gamma-linolenic acid dietary supplementation experiment was conducted exclusively in Lobund-Wistar rats with chemically induced prostatic adenocarcinoma, so it is a preclinical animal study.
